Pickolas Cage

Allergen Call Out: Wheat, Milk, Egg, Soy, Fish

Pre-bake ingredients, bottom to top

  1. 1 ea. Pizza Dough Ball [BOOM 0101]
  2. 50 g Garlic Oil [BOOM 0107]
  3. 85 g Grande Cheese Shredded Mozzarella
  4. 60 g Shredded Fontina
  5. 15 g Shaved Garlic
  6. 25 slices / 135 g Cleveland Pickle Company Dill Pickles, drained
  7. 2 oz Fresh Mozzarella
  8. 5 g Freshly Ground Black Pepper

Post-bake items, in application order

  1. 10 g Romano Cheese, Grated
  2. 35 g Comeback Sauce [SCC 0113]
  3. 15 g Fried Shallots
  4. 8 g Scallions, sliced on a 45° bias
